title: WhatsAppBusinessMessageDeliveryStatusOccurrence
description: Message delivery status occurrence with detailed event information

id.description: Unique identifier for the message delivery status occurrence

error_description.description: Error description if the delivery encountered an error

occurrence_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the delivery status occurrence happened

status_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the status was recorded

webhook_update_state.description: State of the webhook update for this delivery status event

webhook_uri.description: URI of the webhook that received this delivery status update
